params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Damaging {{tip|basic attacks}}, {{tip|abilities}}, [[Named item effect|item effects]], and [[summoner spell]]s, as well as the application of {{tip|crowd control}} and {{tip|damage over time}} effects, apply {{tip|stacks}} against enemy {{tip|champion|champions}}, up to one per {{tip|cast instance}} per champion. Applying 3 stacks to a target within a 3 second period causes them to be struck by lightning after a {{fd|0.25}}-second delay, dealing them {{pp|60 + 10 * x|1 to 20 by 1}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} of either {{as|physical|physical damage}} or {{as|magic damage}}.
params.description2:
{{sbc|Variable Damage:}} This effect deals either {{as|physical|physical damage}} or {{as|magic damage}} depending on the damage contribution from your {{as|{{sti|attack damage}}}} and {{as|{{sti|ability power}}}} to the effect's damage formula.
  • Greater '''bonus damage''' from the {{as|{{sti|AD ratio}}}} → {{as|Physical damage}}
  • Greater '''bonus damage''' from the {{as|{{sti|AP ratio}}}} → {{as|Magic damage}}
If the damage contribution of {{as|{{sti|AD}}}} and {{as|{{sti|AP}}}} are zero or otherwise equal, the damage type defaults to {{as|magic damage}}.
params.caption: {{quote|"We called them the Thunderlords, for to speak of their lightning was to invite disaster."|''Rune caption''}}

description.plain: Passive: Damaging basic attacks, abilities, item effects, and summoner spells, as well as the application of crowd control and damage over time effects, apply stacks against enemy champions, up to one per cast instance per champion. Applying 3 stacks to a target within a 3 second period causes them to be struck by lightning after a 0.25-second delay, dealing them 70 – 260 (based on level) (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 5% AP) of either physical or magic damage.

description2.plain:
Variable Damage: This effect deals either physical or magic damage depending on the damage contribution from your attack damage and ability power to the effect's damage formula.
* Greater bonus damage from the AD ratio → Physical damage
* Greater bonus damage from the AP ratio → Magic damage
If the damage contribution of AD and AP are zero or otherwise equal, the damage type defaults to magic damage.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Dealing {{tip|pet damage|pet}} or non-{{tip|proc damage|proc}} damage against enemy {{tip|champions}} below {{as|50% of their '''maximum''' health}} deals 30 {{as|(+ 11 per Soul)}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} '''bonus''' {{tip|adaptive damage}} and, after a {{fd|1.75}}-second delay, reap {{as|1 Soul}}. This cannot occur again for 35 seconds, resetting to 1 second upon scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion.
params.description2: While not on cooldown, also reap {{as|1 Soul}} from receiving the kill credit of a champion killed by a {{tip|minion}}, {{tip|monster}}, or {{tip|turret}}.

description.plain: Passive: Dealing pet or non-proc damage against enemy champions below 50% of their maximum health deals 30 (+ 11 per Soul) (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 5% AP) bonus adaptive damage and, after a 1.75-second delay, reap 1 Soul. This cannot occur again for 35 seconds, resetting to 1 second upon scoring a takedown against an enemy champion.

description2.plain: While not on cooldown, also reap 1 Soul from receiving the kill credit of a champion killed by a minion, monster, or turret.

description3.plain:
Adaptive Damage: This effect deals either physical or magic damage depending on whether you have more bonus attack damage or ability power.
* Greater bonus attack damage → Physical damage
* Greater ability power → Magic damage
If the damage contribution of AD and AP are zero or otherwise equal, the damage type depends on the champion's adaptive type.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Starting an {{tip|attack windup}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} triggers ''Hail of Blades'', and if the windup completes, you gain 2 stacks of the effect for 3 seconds, with the duration refreshing on basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} against enemy champions until all stacks are consumed. Stacks are consumed per basic attack on-attack and you generate an additional stack of the effect each time you activate an effect that has a {{tip|basic attack reset}}, up to 2 times.
params.description2:
While ''Hail of Blades'' is active, you gain {{as|{{rd|90%|60%}} {{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}|as}}, are allowed to exceed the {{tt|attack speed cap|normally 3.003 attacks per second}}, and basic attacks deal {{pp|2 + (20-2)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=true damage}} {{as|(+ 12% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' true damage}}}}.

''The triggering attack benefits from Hail of Blades.''

description.plain: Passive: Starting an attack windup against an enemy champion triggers Hail of Blades, and if the windup completes, you gain 2 stacks of the effect for 3 seconds, with the duration refreshing on basic attacks on-attack against enemy champions until all stacks are consumed. Stacks are consumed per basic attack on-attack and you generate an additional stack of the effect each time you activate an effect that has a basic attack reset, up to 2 times.

description2.plain: While Hail of Blades is active, you gain 90% (melee) / 60% (ranged) bonus attack speed, are allowed to exceed the attack speed cap, and basic attacks deal 2 – 22.12 (based on level) (+ 12% bonus AD) (+ 10% AP) bonus true damage. The triggering attack benefits from Hail of Blades.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Non-{{tip|proc damage|proc}} damage sources deal {{as|{{pp|10 + (45-10)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}}|true damage}} {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} to enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} affected by certain {{tip|crowd control}} effects.
params.description3: The target must already be impaired prior to the damaging attack or spell in order to trigger the '''bonus''' damage.

description.plain: Passive: Non-proc damage sources deal 10 – 49.12 (based on level) bonus true damage to enemy champions affected by certain crowd control effects.

description2.plain:
Valid Crowd Control:
* Immobilizes
* Blind
* Disarm
* Ground
* Nearsight
* Polymorph
* Silence
* Slow

description3.plain: The target must already be impaired prior to the damaging attack or spell in order to trigger the bonus damage.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Damaging an enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|heal|heals}} you for {{pp|16 + (40-16)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}}.
params.description2: Does not trigger at full health.

description.plain: Passive: Damaging an enemy champion heals you for 16 – 42.82 (based on level) (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 5% AP).

description2.plain: Does not trigger at full health.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Dealing damage to an enemy {{tip|champion}} within 4 seconds of using a {{tip|dash}} or {{tip|blink}}, or exiting from {{tip|stealth}}, deals {{as|{{pp|20 to 80}} '''bonus''' true damage}} to them.
params.cooldown: {{tt|10|Starts post-effect (after bonus damage is applied or expires)}}

description.plain: Passive: Dealing damage to an enemy champion within 4 seconds of using a dash or blink, or exiting from stealth, deals 20 – 80 (based on level) bonus true damage to them.

cooldown.note: Starts post-effect (after bonus damage is applied or expires)

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Upon moving near an un-tracked enemy {{tip|ward}}, it is automatically tracked with a [[File:Enemy Ward time indicator.png|30px|link=]] [[Ward#Ward_Timers|ward timer]].
params.description2: At level 11, also {{tip|true sight|reveals}} the ward for 10 seconds upon being triggered.

description.plain: Passive: Upon moving near an un-tracked enemy ward, it is automatically tracked with a ward timer.

description2.plain: At level 11, also reveals the ward for 10 seconds upon being triggered.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Gain 6 [[trinket haste]] per ''Memento'' stack, up to 108 haste at maximum stacks.
params.description2: Earn a ''Memento'' stack whenever scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}}, up to 18 stacks.

description.plain: Passive: Gain 6 trinket haste per Memento stack, up to 108 haste at maximum stacks.

description2.plain: Earn a Memento stack whenever scoring a champion takedown, up to 18 stacks.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{tip|Stealth Ward|Stealth Wards}} and {{tip|Totem Ward|Totem Wards}} placed in the enemy jungle are considered ''Deep''. All ''Deep'' wards are granted {{as|1 '''bonus''' health}}, ''Deep'' {{tip|Stealth Ward|Stealth Wards}} last {{pp|30 to 45|type=average champion level}} seconds longer, and ''Deep'' {{tip|Totem Ward|Totem Wards}} last {{pp|45 to 150|type=average champion level}} seconds longer.
params.description2: At level 9, wards placed in the river will also be considered ''Deep''.

description.plain: Passive: Stealth Wards and Totem Wards placed in the enemy jungle are considered Deep. All Deep wards are granted 1 bonus health, Deep Stealth Wards last 30 – 45 (based on average champion level) seconds longer, and Deep Totem Wards last 45 – 150 (based on average champion level) seconds longer.

description2.plain: At level 9, wards placed in the river will also be considered Deep.

params.description: Gain {{g|50}} (+ {{g|20}} per ''Bounty Hunter'' stack) per unique takedown, up to {{g|{{ap|(50*5)+(20*10)}}}} at 5 unique takedowns.
params.description3: Earn a ''Bounty Hunter'' [[stack]] whenever scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion, up to one per unique champion.

description.plain: Gain 50 gold (+ 20 gold per Bounty Hunter stack) per unique takedown, up to 450 gold at 5 unique takedowns.

description2.plain: 1st unique takedown: 50 gold, 2nd: 70 gold, 3rd: 90 gold, 4th: 110 gold, 5th: 130 gold.

description3.plain: Earn a Bounty Hunter stack whenever scoring a takedown against an enemy champion, up to one per unique champion.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Gain {{sti|{{as|8 '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while [[combat status|out of combat]] per ''Bounty Hunter'' stack, up to {{as|40|ms}} at 5 stacks.
params.description2: Earn a ''Bounty Hunter'' [[stack]] whenever scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion, up to one per unique champion.

description.plain: Passive: Gain 8 bonus movement speed while out of combat per Bounty Hunter stack, up to 40 at 5 stacks.

description2.plain: Earn a Bounty Hunter stack whenever scoring a takedown against an enemy champion, up to one per unique champion.

params.description: Gain 6 (+ 5 per ''Bounty Hunter'' [[stack]]) [[ultimate haste]], up to 31 at 5 stacks.
params.description2: Earn a ''Bounty Hunter'' stack whenever scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}}, up to one per unique champion.

description.plain: Gain 6 (+ 5 per Bounty Hunter stack) ultimate haste, up to 31 at 5 stacks.

description2.plain: Earn a Bounty Hunter stack whenever scoring a takedown against an enemy champion, up to one per unique champion.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{tip|immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy {{tip|champion}} will cause 3 glacial rays to emanate from them towards you and other nearby enemy champions, creating icy zones with a 700 unit radius that last for 3 (+ 100% of the {{tt|immobilizing effect's duration|Duration after being modified by tenacity}}) seconds.
params.description2: Enemies within the icy zones, which have a width of 80 units, are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% {{as|(+ 7% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ 9% per 10% heal and shield power)}} and have their damage reduced by 15% against your allies, excluding yourself.

description.plain: Passive: Immobilizing an enemy champion will cause 3 glacial rays to emanate from them towards you and other nearby enemy champions, creating icy zones with a 700 unit radius that last for 3 (+ 100% of the immobilizing effect's duration) seconds.

description2.plain: Enemies within the icy zones, which have a width of 80 units, are slowed by 20% (+ 7% per 100 bonus AD) (+ 6% per 100 AP) (+ 9% per 10% heal and shield power) and have their damage reduced by 15% against your allies, excluding yourself.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While not channeling {{si|Teleport}} and being [[combat status|out-of-combat]] for 5 seconds, you can swap one of your equipped [[summoner spell]]s to a new, single use summoner spell. You cannot select a summoner spell you have already equipped.
params.description2: Your first swap becomes available at {{sbc|{{MinuteDisplay|360}}}}. Swaps have an initial cooldown of 270 seconds; selecting a unique summoner spell reduces the swap cooldown by 25 seconds. You must swap to 3 different summoner spells before returning to one you have already used.
params.description3: Selecting a summoner spell places it on a 5-second cooldown. Using a selected summoner spell places the summoner spell in the same slot on a 10-second cooldown.
params.cooldown: {{pp|type=unique swaps|270-25 to 270-25*6 for 6|1 to 6|formula=270 base - 25 per unique swap. ''This is capped at 120 seconds at 6 swaps.''}}

description.plain: Passive: While not channeling Teleport and being out-of-combat for 5 seconds, you can swap one of your equipped summoner spells to a new, single use summoner spell. You cannot select a summoner spell you have already equipped.

description2.plain: Your first swap becomes available at 6:00. Swaps have an initial cooldown of 270 seconds; selecting a unique summoner spell reduces the swap cooldown by 25 seconds. You must swap to 3 different summoner spells before returning to one you have already used.

description3.plain: Selecting a summoner spell places it on a 5-second cooldown. Using a selected summoner spell places the summoner spell in the same slot on a 10-second cooldown.

cooldown.formula: 270 base - 25 per unique swap. This is capped at 120 seconds at 6 swaps.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Initiating [[combat]] with an enemy {{tip|champion}} within the first {{fd|0.25}} seconds of champion combat, grants {{g|10}} and ''First Strike'' for 3 seconds, causing all of your {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt against champions to deal {{as|7% '''bonus''' true damage}}. Afterwards, you are granted {{g|gold}} equal to {{rd|50%|35%}} of all '''bonus''' damage dealt within the duration.
params.description2: ''First Strike'' will be placed on full cooldown without activating its effects after being struck by an enemy champion before you strike them.

description.plain: Passive: Initiating combat with an enemy champion within the first 0.25 seconds of champion combat, grants 10 gold and First Strike for 3 seconds, causing all of your post-mitigation damage dealt against champions to deal 7% bonus true damage. Afterwards, you are granted gold gold equal to 50% (melee) / 35% (ranged) of all bonus damage dealt within the duration.

description2.plain: First Strike will be placed on full cooldown without activating its effects after being struck by an enemy champion before you strike them.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While {{si|Flash}} has a remaining cooldown greater than 2 seconds, it is replaced by ''{{si|Hexflash}}''.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} You begin {{tip|channel|charging}} for up to 2 seconds, setting your {{sti|ms|{{as|movement speed}}}} to a {{as|static 0|ms}}, and increasing ''Hexflash's'' range over the duration. After at least 1 second, you can reactivate the spell, which is automatically done so when the charge completes without reactivation. Releasing the charge earlier than 1 second or entering combat with an enemy {{tip|champion}} will put ''Hexflash'' on {{sti|cooldown}} for 10 seconds.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} You {{tip|blink}} to the target location within range and gain {{sti|ms|{{as|{{tt|50%}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for up to {{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|random, estimated}} seconds.
params.description4: ''Uses Quick Casting by default, which requires the Active to be held and the Recast to occur on release.''
params.range: {{pp|type=channel time|200 to 400 for 6|1 to 2.5|formula=200 + 40 every 0.3 seconds}}

description.plain: Passive: While Flash has a remaining cooldown greater than 2 seconds, it is replaced by Hexflash.

description2.plain: Active: You begin charging for up to 2 seconds, setting your movement speed to a static 0, and increasing Hexflash's range over the duration. After at least 1 second, you can reactivate the spell, which is automatically done so when the charge completes without reactivation. Releasing the charge earlier than 1 second or entering combat with an enemy champion will put Hexflash on cooldown for 10 seconds.

description3.plain: Recast: You blink to the target location within range and gain 50% bonus movement speed for up to 0.25 seconds.

description4.plain: Uses Quick Casting by default, which requires the Active to be held and the Recast to occur on release.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} After 12 minutes (reduced by 45 seconds whenever scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion), you gain {{ii|Slightly Magical Boots}} for {{g|free}}. ''Slightly Magical Boots'' are identical to {{ii|Boots}} and can be upgraded as if it were the item. If the inventory is full while receiving the boots, they will appear as soon as a slot in the inventory is available.
params.description2: Additionally, your boots grant an additional {{sti|{{as|10 '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
params.description3: You cannot purchase {{ii|Boots}} nor any Tier-2 [[boots]] prior to obtaining ''Slightly Magical Boots''.

description.plain: Passive: After 12 minutes (reduced by 45 seconds whenever scoring a takedown against an enemy champion), you gain Slightly Magical Boots for free gold. Slightly Magical Boots are identical to Boots and can be upgraded as if it were the item. If the inventory is full while receiving the boots, they will appear as soon as a slot in the inventory is available.

description2.plain: Additionally, your boots grant an additional 10 bonus movement speed.

description3.plain: You cannot purchase Boots nor any Tier-2 boots prior to obtaining Slightly Magical Boots.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Upon purchasing a [[Legendary item]], you are automatically refunded {{fd|7.5}}% of its total {{g|gold}} cost.
params.description2: ''Selling or undoing the item's purchase will cancel the refund, reducing your current {{g|gold}} equal to the refunded amount.''

description.plain: Passive: Upon purchasing a Legendary item, you are automatically refunded 7.5% of its total gold gold cost.

description2.plain: Selling or undoing the item's purchase will cancel the refund, reducing your current gold gold equal to the refunded amount.

params.description2: If the inventory is full upon the user becoming eligible to receive {{ii|Elixir of Avarice}} or {{ii|Elixir of Force}}, each item will be granted as soon as an empty slot is available. If the inventory is full upon becoming eligible to receive {{ii|Elixir of Skill}}, the item is consumed automatically.

description.plain:
Passive: Gain an Elixir upon reaching each of the following levels:
* Level 3: Elixir of Avarice
* Level 6: Elixir of Force
* Level 9: Elixir of Skill

description2.plain: If the inventory is full upon the user becoming eligible to receive Elixir of Avarice or Elixir of Force, each item will be granted as soon as an empty slot is available. If the inventory is full upon becoming eligible to receive Elixir of Skill, the item is consumed automatically.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Upon consuming a potion ({{ii|Health Potion|icononly=true}}{{ii|Refillable Potion|icononly=true}}), you additionally {{tip|heal}} equal to 40% of its '''total''' health restoration.
params.description2: If a health potion is consumed while one is already active, this effect will trigger on the activation of the next potion once the restoration of the current one ends.

description.plain: Passive: Upon consuming a potion (Health PotionRefillable Potion), you additionally heal equal to 40% of its total health restoration.

description2.plain: If a health potion is consumed while one is already active, this effect will trigger on the activation of the next potion once the restoration of the current one ends.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Receive a {{ii|Total Biscuit of Everlasting Will}} at {{sbc|2:00}}, {{sbc|4:00}}, and {{sbc|6:00}}. If the inventory is full while receiving a biscuit, the biscuit(s) will appear as soon as a slot in the inventory is available.
params.description2: Consuming a ''Biscuit'' will permanently increase your {{as|{{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} by {{as|30|health}}, in addition to its effects. You will also gain the increased health if you sell the biscuit for {{g|5}}.

description.plain: Passive: Receive a Total Biscuit of Everlasting Will at 2:00, 4:00, and 6:00. If the inventory is full while receiving a biscuit, the biscuit(s) will appear as soon as a slot in the inventory is available.

description2.plain: Consuming a Biscuit will permanently increase your maximum health by 30, in addition to its effects. You will also gain the increased health if you sell the biscuit for 5 gold.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Gain 18 [[ability haste#Increasing summoner spell haste|summoner spell haste]] and 10 [[ability haste#Increasing item haste|item haste]].

description.plain: Passive: Gain 18 summoner spell haste and 10 item haste.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Gain {{sti|{{as|{{fd|7.5}}% '''bonus total''' movement speed}}}} while facing {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} that are {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|slow|slowed}} within {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 1000 range.
params.description2: This bonus is doubled to {{as|15%|ms}} and does not have a range cap nor require {{tip|sight|vision}} toward enemy champions whose movement you impaired when they were {{tip|sight|visible}}.{{bug|2}}

description.plain: Passive: Gain 7.5% bonus total movement speed while facing visible enemy champions that are immobilized, grounded, or slowed within 1000 range.

description2.plain: This bonus is doubled to 15% and does not have a range cap nor require vision toward enemy champions whose movement you impaired when they were visible.(unexpected)

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Dealing damage to enemy {{tip|champions}} generates {{tip|stacks}} of ''Conqueror'', lasting for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damage against champions, and stacking up to 12 times. Gain {{rd|2|1}} stacks for {{tip|basic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. Otherwise, gain 2 stacks for any damage that is neither {{tip|basic damage|basic}} nor non-{{tip|pet damage|pet}} {{tip|proc damage}}, up to once every 4 seconds per {{tip|cast instance}}.
params.description2: Each stack of ''Conqueror'' grants {{adaptive|1.8 + (4-1.8)/17*(x-1)|20}}, up to {{adaptive|1.8*12 + (4*12-1.8*12)/17*(x-1)|20}} at maximum stacks, at which you also {{tip|heal}} for {{rd|8%|5%}} of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt against enemy champions.

description.plain: Passive: Dealing damage to enemy champions generates stacks of Conqueror, lasting for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damage against champions, and stacking up to 12 times. Gain 2 (melee) / 1 (ranged) stacks for basic damage on-hit. Otherwise, gain 2 stacks for any damage that is neither basic nor non-pet proc damage, up to once every 4 seconds per cast instance.

description2.plain: Each stack of Conqueror grants 1.08 – 2.56 (based on level) bonus Attack Damage or 1.8 – 4.26 (based on level) Ability Power (Adaptive), up to 12.96 – 30.66 (based on level) bonus Attack Damage or 21.6 – 51.11 (based on level) Ability Power (Adaptive) at maximum stacks, at which you also heal for 8% (melee) / 5% (ranged) of the post-mitigation damage dealt against enemy champions.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Entering [[Combat status|combat]] generates 1 [[stack]] every second for the next 3 seconds, refreshing the duration with each instance of combat and stacking the effect up to 4 times. At maximum stacks, your next [[basic attack]] {{tip|on-hit}} within 5 seconds against an enemy {{tip|champion}} consumes all stacks to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{rd|{{fd|3.5}}%|{{fd|1.4}}%}} of your '''maximum''' health}}, {{tip|heal}} you for {{as|{{rd|{{fd|1.3}}%|{{fd|0.52}}%}} of your '''maximum''' health)}}, and permanently grant you {{as|{{rd|5|2}} '''bonus''' health}}.

description.plain: Passive: Entering combat generates 1 stack every second for the next 3 seconds, refreshing the duration with each instance of combat and stacking the effect up to 4 times. At maximum stacks, your next basic attack on-hit within 5 seconds against an enemy champion consumes all stacks to deal bonus magic damage equal to 3.5% (melee) / 1.4% (ranged) of your maximum health, heal you for 1.3% (melee) / 0.52% (ranged) of your maximum health), and permanently grant you 5 (melee) / 2 (ranged) bonus health.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy {{tip|champion}} grants you a static {{as|45|armor}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} and {{as|45|mr}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds. The '''bonus''' resistances are each capped at {{pp|80 to 150}}.
params.description2: After the duration, you release a shockwave that deals {{as|{{pp|25 to 120}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 8% of your '''bonus''' health)}} {{as|magic damage}} to enemy champions and {{tip|monster|monsters}} within a {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 350 radius.

description.plain: Passive: Immobilizing an enemy champion grants you a static 45 (+ 75% bonus armor) bonus armor and 45 (+ 75% bonus magic resistance) bonus magic resistance for 2.5 seconds. The bonus resistances are each capped at 80 – 150 (based on level).

description2.plain: After the duration, you release a shockwave that deals 25 – 120 (based on level) (+ 8% of your bonus health) magic damage to enemy champions and monsters within a 350 radius.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While within 350 units of an allied {{tip|champion}}, you raise your ''Guard''. Allied champions you affect with [[unit-targeted]] [[champion ability|abilities]] are also ''Guarded'' for 3 seconds, regardless of distance.
params.description2: If you or a ''Guarded'' ally would take {{pp|50 + (165-50)/17*(x-1) for 20}} damage within {{fd|2.5}} seconds or lethal damage from an enemy champion, {{tip|monster}} or {{tip|turret}}, you both gain a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|40 + (150-40)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 20% of your AP)}} {{as|(+ 6% of your '''bonus''' health)}} for 2 seconds.
params.description3: ''Guardian'' only goes on {{sti|cooldown}} when the shield is triggered.

description.plain: Passive: While within 350 units of an allied champion, you raise your Guard. Allied champions you affect with unit-targeted abilities are also Guarded for 3 seconds, regardless of distance.

description2.plain: If you or a Guarded ally would take 50 – 178.53 (based on level) damage within 2.5 seconds or lethal damage from an enemy champion, monster or turret, you both gain a shield for 40 – 162.94 (based on level) (+ 20% of your AP) (+ 6% of your bonus health) for 2 seconds.

description3.plain: Guardian only goes on cooldown when the shield is triggered.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} against {{tip|turrets}} apply a stack of ''Demolish'', stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a turret consumes them all to deal {{as|{{rd|85|50}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{rd|28%|20%}} of your '''maximum''' health)}} {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}|physical}}.
params.description2: ''Demolish'' cannot be triggered on the same turret by any of its users more than once every 3 seconds.

description.plain: Passive: Basic attacks on-hit against turrets apply a stack of Demolish, stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a turret consumes them all to deal 85 (melee) / 50 (ranged) (+ 28% (melee) / 20% (ranged) of your maximum health) bonus physical damage.

description2.plain: Demolish cannot be triggered on the same turret by any of its users more than once every 3 seconds.

cooldown.note: Global cooldown on all turrets, starts after consuming stacks on a turret

description.plain: Passive: Slowing or immobilizing an enemy champion heals you and the nearest and most wounded allied champion within 1000 units for 10 – 54.71 (melee) / 7 – 38.29 (ranged) (based on your level).

The empowered attack lasts for up to 2 seconds after the shield expires.
params.description2: {{Tip data/Adaptive damage|pst2|description}}

description2.plain:
Adaptive Damage: This effect deals either physical or magic damage depending on whether you have more bonus attack damage or ability power.
* Greater bonus attack damage → Physical damage
* Greater ability power → Magic damage
If the damage contribution of AD and AP are zero or otherwise equal, the damage type depends on the champion's adaptive type.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Damaging {{tip|basic attacks}}, {{tip|abilities}}, and [[Named item effect|item effects]] against an enemy {{tip|champion}} signal ''Aery'' to pounce at them over {{fd|0.45}} seconds, dealing {{pp|10 + (40/17)*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} {{tip|adaptive damage}}. {{tip|Healing}}, {{tip|shield|shielding}}, or {{tip|buff|buffing}} an allied champion signals ''Aery'' to leap to their side over {{fd|0.35}} seconds, {{tip|shield|shielding}} them for {{pp|20 + (100-20)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
params.description2: ''Aery'' applies her effects to the affected champion upon arrival. She then lingers on the target for {{tt|2 seconds|Slightly less than this duration}} before flying back to the user, and cannot be sent out again until she returns. While on her way back, she is {{tt|initially very slow|return speed's initial value is 200 at levels 1-5, 300 at levels 6-10 and 600 at level 11+}}, but {{tt|gradually accelerates|+10 speed per 51 units she travels}}, and {{tt|can be picked up by moving near her|+2000 speed per 51 units traveled after coming within 200 units of the user}}.

description.plain: Passive: Damaging basic attacks, abilities, and item effects against an enemy champion signal Aery to pounce at them over 0.45 seconds, dealing 10 – 54.71 (based on level) (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 5% AP) adaptive damage. Healing, shielding, or buffing an allied champion signals Aery to leap to their side over 0.35 seconds, shielding them for 20 – 109.41 (based on level) (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 5% AP) for 2.5 seconds.

description2.plain: Aery applies her effects to the affected champion upon arrival. She then lingers on the target for 2 seconds before flying back to the user, and cannot be sent out again until she returns. While on her way back, she is initially very slow, but gradually accelerates, and can be picked up by moving near her.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Dealing {{tip|ability damage}} or {{tip|pet damage}} to an enemy {{tip|champion}} hurls an ''Arcane Comet'' at their current location that lands after {{rutngt|0.8}}, dealing {{pp|15 + (100-15)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} of either {{as|physical|physical damage}} or {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within a {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 140 radius upon impact. This damage is increased by {{pp|0 to 100 by 5|0 to 750|key=%|label1=units|type=distance the comet travelled|label=damage increase}}, up to a {{ccs||physical}}{{ccs|maximum|magic}} of {{pp|15*2 + (200-30)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*2}}% AP)}} at maximum range.
params.description2:
{{sbc|Variable Damage:}} This effect deals either {{as|physical|physical damage}} or {{as|magic damage}} depending on the damage contribution from your {{as|{{sti|attack damage}}}} and {{as|{{sti|ability power}}}} to the effect's damage formula.
  • Greater '''bonus damage''' from the {{as|{{sti|AD ratio}}}} → {{as|Physical damage}}
  • Greater '''bonus damage''' from the {{as|{{sti|AP ratio}}}} → {{as|Magic damage}}
If the damage contribution of {{as|{{sti|AD}}}} and {{as|{{sti|AP}}}} are zero or otherwise equal, the damage type defaults to {{as|magic damage}}.

description.plain: Passive: Dealing ability damage or pet damage to an enemy champion hurls an Arcane Comet at their current location that lands after 0.825 seconds (0.8 seconds rounded up to the next game tick), dealing 15 – 110 (based on level) (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 5% AP) of either physical or magic damage to enemies within a 140 radius upon impact. This damage is increased by 0% – 100% (based on distance the comet travelled), up to a maximum of 30 – 220 (based on level) (+ 20% bonus AD) (+ 10% AP) at maximum range.

description2.plain:
Variable Damage: This effect deals either physical or magic damage depending on the damage contribution from your attack damage and ability power to the effect's damage formula.
* Greater bonus damage from the AD ratio → Physical damage
* Greater bonus damage from the AP ratio → Magic damage
If the damage contribution of AD and AP are zero or otherwise equal, the damage type defaults to magic damage.
